shortBulletSummary: Renewed US-Iran hostilities are raising oil prices, contributing to a risk-off sentiment in crypto markets.
Bitcoin shows price swings around $63K-$64K due to mixed macroeconomic data and over $386M in long position liquidations.
Overall market sentiment remains balanced, with the Crypto Fear & Greed Index hovering between 49 and 54.
Ethereum exhibits relative strength against Bitcoin but grapples with negative US investor sentiment and recent liquidations.
Morgan Stanley's E*TRADE has rolled out spot trading for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana for eligible clients, signaling growing institutional adoption.
